name: default
description: WordPress-on-Worker zone cache (deploy/zone, CR #18): cache anonymous HTML at the edge, then bypass dynamic/admin/session. ORDER MATTERS: Cache Rules use LAST-MATCH-WINS for the non-terminating set_cache_settings action, so the bypass rule is LAST on purpose. A cart/logged-in request matches BOTH rules; the bypass (cache:false) runs last and wins, so a cart or logged-in page is never cached. @HOSTNAME@ is substituted by apply.sh (MODE=dedicated).

rules.description: Cache anonymous HTML for this host at the edge (origin is the Worker). First rule; the bypass rule below overrides it for any dynamic/session request (last match wins).

Bypass cache for admin, auth, API, cron, cart/checkout/account, any logged-in / password / preferences / comment-author / WooCommerce (incl. wp_woocommerce_session) cookie, and any non-GET method. LAST rule: on a request that also matched the cache rule above, this cache:false wins (last match wins), so a cart or logged-in page is never served from the edge cache.
rules.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-admin")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-login")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-json")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-cron")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cart")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/checkout")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/my-account")) or (http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in") or (http.cookie contains "wp-postpass") or (http.cookie contains "wp-settings") or (http.cookie contains "comment_author") or (http.cookie contains "woocommerce_") or (http.request.method ne "GET")
